Use @Image1 as the starting frame.
Steady handheld drift right follows @Image2 as she finishes slipping the @Image3 into her shorts pocket with her left hand, then snatches the striped beach towel from the chair with her right. She pivots toward the open balcony door and walks forward into the bright exterior, white linen clothing and sheer curtains stirring lightly. Soft smile holds as she exits. Sunlit dust motes drift; ocean waves move in background.

soft coastal breeze through open doors, distant ocean waves, quiet sunny apartment. soft fabric rustle of linen shorts as lipstick is pocketed, towel fabric swipe as it is snatched from the chair, light footsteps on wood floor, sheer curtains shifting.

Single continuous shot, no cuts. Avoid jitter and bent limbs.
